The 1.8-liter engine in the LE trim is known for low maintenance demands, with owners frequently reporting minimal issues beyond routine services like oil changes, air filters, and tires. The CVTi-S transmission, while not universally loved by enthusiasts, has a solid track record in normal driving conditions when fluid is serviced at recommended intervals.
